name: Dolm
fantasy: The quarry-hand. Raises stone out of the ground, then hits it, and hits you.
silhouette: the stone shoulder and the heavy fists

card.loop: Raise rocks with Rockwave or a dash, then punch or slam them into the enemy. A slam that knocks resets itself.
card.dash: Barrel forward and shove a boulder out ahead of you as you land.
card.passive: Sneak to feel enemies in front of you through walls and fog.
card.rmb: Hold to gather, let go to slam: the centre stuns, rocks nearby fly. Kills and knocks reset it.
card.e: Raise a wall of three rocks in front of you. Punch or slam them into foes.

weapons.rubble_fists: Tap throws a boulder. Hold and let go to punch: it launches foes, stuns them on walls and sends rocks flying.

passive.name: Stonesight
passive.desc: While sneaking, every enemy within 16m in a 70 degree cone in front of you shows through walls and fog as a stone ring for half a second, refreshed while you keep sneaking.

dash.name: Landslide
dash.desc: A 4.2m barrel forward. As you land, a boulder you shoved ahead rockets 12m: 12 damage, a shove and Shred (+15% damage taken for 3s).

variants.tap: A quick slam 2.4m ahead: 14 damage and a shove, rocks in the ring fly outward.
variants.hold: Hold up to 0.8s: a bigger, harder slam (up to 30) whose centre stuns up to 1.2s.
variants.air: In the air you dive, and slam where you land. A foe caught in the air is spiked down for +40%, +20 more over the abyss.

e.name: Rockwave
e.desc: Raise three rocks in a line 3m ahead (on solid ground only, never into bodies). They stop foes and shots, hold 9s, and any punch, slam or dash-launch sends one flying.

rank3.sec: slamming a foe or a rock gives a shield of 18, up to 4 stacks
rank3.dash: the barrel runs a third further
rank3.kin: a second row of rocks, and cast over the abyss it raises a temporary rock bridge

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 10s -> 8s, damage +30%; slamming a foe or a rock gives a shield of 18, up to 4 stacks.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 13s -> 10.4s; a second row of rocks, and over the abyss a rock bridge.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 9s -> 6.3s; the barrel runs a third further.

tells.half: stone pebbles orbit the shoulder, one per live rock
